dct_description_sm: This dataset describes the vegetation density, diversity, and species distribution of seven stabilized retrogressive thaw slumps at Thetis Bay, Herschel Island. The purpose of the dataset is to offer a quantitative resource for the analysis of revegetation and act as a high-resolution benchmark for future climate change.
dct_title_s: Species distribution and diversity at seven stabilized retrogressive thaw slumps, Thetis Bay, Herschel Island, YT, Canada
